parse_training_options: parse command line arguments for TART contrastive learning training configuration
print_options_to_file: print parsed training options to console and save them to opt.txt
configure_contrastive_mode: configure MoCo contrastive learning parameters like queue size, temperature, and momentum
set_bi_encoder_options: set bi-encoder mode with separate query and context encoders for retrieval
configure_finetuning_params: configure finetuning parameters including negative contexts, hard negatives, and knowledge distillation
